contour-equivalence.method: Actual production scene render computes opaqueWorld and fitted root transforms. Override only one drawing sample at a time to five authored keys and two frozen clocks, then isolate that actor root for native GPU RGBA. Diagnostic pose sampling, not gameplay/FPS evidence; no unbuilt source imports.

drawing-equivalence.method: Diagnostic frozen poses on the exact production judge URL. Original vertex buffers, sockets, face corners and feet across pose boundaries/reduced motion; isolated actor-root GPU RGBA at five drawings and two clocks. Not ordinary gameplay or FPS evidence.
